videoObservationScope: Official FFmpeg on Windows decoded existing Linux native recordings at duration1/3 and2/3 into memory only. Requested seeks are not independently measured exact PTS. No browser or new capture.
pngScope: 18 final default endpoints after four switches return to each case initial design/mode; medium/standard frame crops. These are not four-variant intermediate screenshots or full pages.
motionRecheck: 72/72 retain>=3committed frames, finite natural completion, strictly increasing rAF, changed card background and all5foreground roles, final/each committed nearest boundary, every committed palette==own run final endpoint, same nodes/draft; byte hashes also match native JSON and embedded native HTML JSON.
observations: No final PNG showed theme palette mismatch; actual PNG/native/HTML hashes all agree.
WebKit shadcn titles visually heavier in2PNGs; cause/fontWeight not measured by this batch, not promoted to a source defect.
Firefox md3/light requested1.680s frame was preview-loading prerequisite, not a Card appearance pass.
Chromium apple/dark requested2.293s frame shows magnified content/right gray fill; recording geometry observation only, not a real browser zoom proof.
WebKit video sample text/border pixels are visibly rough at800x450; use native original PNGs for text/outline detail, not decoded video as pixel goldens.
limits: Browser rAF timestamps are live callback observations, not all actual compositor frames or native video exact PTS.
Only this18-case theme scope is covered; full Card state/size/density/environment matrix remains pending.
The current global working tree may contain subsequent Number test-only changes; these immutable worker source/artifact identifiers were not rewritten.
No source/report/baseline/canonical/verified changes; only these review JSON/MD outputs.
